'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[Israel]] launches an attack on [[Iran]], calling it a [[Preemptive war|preemptive strike]], killing several Iranian high-ranking officials including [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]]. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-iran-attack-02-28-26-hnk-intl?post-id=cmm6r22el000c357505j8ahxy (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/israel-iran-live-updates-rcna261099 (NBC News)]
**The [[United States]] takes part in the attack on Iran with president Trump announcing a "major U.S. combat operation" targeting [[Iran's ballistic-missile program|Iranian missile facilities]] and [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|naval]] assets, and calls on the [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian military]] to overthrow Khamenei. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202602281238 (Iran International)] [https://www.ynet.co.il/news/blogs/article/hyvvmuyywl?#HyezEabeKZg (Ynet)]
**Explosions are reported in [[Tehran]], Iran, as U.S.-launched [[Tomahawk missile]]s strike Iranian targets, including the [[Office of the Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader's office]]. [[Satellite imagery]] confirms the destruction of Khamenei's compound. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/satellite-image-shows-destruction-of-khameneis-compound/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/witnesses-hear-explosion-irans-capital-061713591.html (AP)] [https://middle-east-online.com/en/us-israel-strike-irans-leadership-targets (Middle East Online)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn5ge95q6y7t (BBC News)]
**Iran launches [[ballistic missile]]s at a [[United States Navy]] facility in [[Bahrain]], targeting the headquarters of the [[U.S. Fifth Fleet]], and Iranian [[Drone warfare|drones strike]] residential areas of [[Manama]]. The [[Ministry of Interior (Bahrain)|Bahraini interior ministry]] urges citizens and residents to seek nearest safe locations. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-explosion-tehran-c2f11247d8a66e36929266f2c557a54c (AP)] [https://www.alkhaleej.ae/2026-02-28/%D8%B5%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B0%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A8-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC%D9%87-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A3%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8 (AFP via ''Al Khaleej'')] [https://defensemirror.com/news/41210/U_S__Naval_Base_in_Bahrain_under_Attack_from_Iran__20_Storey_Building_Damaged_in_Manama (Defense Mirror)]
**The [[Cabinet of Israel]] declares a [[state of emergency]] related to the strikes on Iran. Israel closes all [[Gaza–Israel barrier|border crossings]] with the [[Gaza Strip]], citing security measures, and suspends the rotation of [[Humanitarian aid to Gaza|humanitarian personnel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-and-israel-launch-major-joint-assault-on-iran-trump-indicates-goal-is-to-topple-regime/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/9186526/israel-closes-rafah-border-crossing-into-gaza-again/ (AAP via ''The Canberra Times'')]
**Iran launches missiles at Bahrain, [[Jordan]], [[Kuwait]], [[Saudi Arabia]], and the [[United Arab Emirates]] (UAE). Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, [[Qatar]], and the UAE state that they have intercepted Iranian missiles. The [[Embassy of the United States, Manama|U.S. embassies in Bahrain]] and Qatar instruct their personnel to [[Shelter-in-place|shelter in place]]. [https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1496336/us-embassy-in-qatar-orders-lockdown-for-staff.html (AFP via ''L'Orient–Le Jour'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/afp-loud-explosions-heard-saudi-capital-riyadh (''Middle East Eye'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-fires-missiles-gulf-arab-states-one-killed-abu-dhabi-2026-02-28/ (Reuters)] [https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/167825 (Wafa)]
**​At least two people are killed and five more are injured when an unidentified [[airstrike]] targets the [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] headquarters in [[Jurf al-Nasr]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/air-strike-hits-iraqi-base-hosting-pro-iran-militia-sources-say/ (AFP via ''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.annahar.com/international/iran/281231/%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%87%D9%88%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%81-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B4%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B9%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AE%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%82%D9%88%D8%B7-%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%AD%D9%89 (''An-Nahar'')]  [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/02/28/iran-backed-militias-in-iraq-say-us-israel-attack-kills-at-least-two-fighters/ (''The National'')]
**Iran, Iraq, Israel, Kuwait, Qatar, and Syria close their respective [[airspace]]s to civilian flights as a precautionary measure, while the UAE partially closes its airspace. Later, the UAE indefinitely suspends all flights from the [[Al Maktoum International Airport|Al Maktoum]] and [[Dubai International Airport|Dubai international airports]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/bulletin/news/dubai-flights-cancelled-iran-attack-airspace-airport-b2929467.html (''The Independent'')] [https://gulfnews.com/uae/gulf-countries-close-airspace-uae-qatar-kuwait-bahrain-suspend-flights-amid-regional-strikes-1.500458416 (''Gulf News'')] [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/indigo-issues-advisory-after-iran-israel-and-iraq-shut-airspace-over-strikes-closely-monitoring-101772267982181.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
**Iranian [[Shahed drones]] strike [[Kuwait International Airport]] resulting in minor injures to several airport workers as well as damage to the main [[airport terminal]]. [https://timeskuwait.com/kuwait-airport-targetted-by-drones/ (''The Times Kuwait'')]
**Iran says it has launched a [[ballistic missile]] attack on [[Dubai]] with reports of multiple missiles striking the city. At least one hotel on the [[Palm Islands]] is hit and is ablaze, injuring at least four people. The [[Burj Khalifa]] is evacuated. An Iranian drone strikes the [[hotel|luxury hotel]] [[Burj Al Arab]] causing a fire. [https://news.az/news/breaking-iranian-drone-hit-the-five-star-burj-al-arab-hot-el-in-dubai (News.az)] [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/burj-khalifa-evacuated-why-dubai-authorities-are-asking-people-to-vacate-worlds-tallest-building-101772294564291.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn5ge95q6y7t (BBC News)] [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-dubai-hotel-erupts-flames-36796610 (''The Mirror'')]
**[[Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics (Iran)|Iranian defence minister]] [[Aziz Nasirzadeh]], [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) commander [[Mohammad Pakpour]], and [[Expediency Discernment Council]] member [[Ali Shamkhani]] are killed by Israeli strikes. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/364834 (AFP via BSS)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-defence-minister-guards-commander-killed-israeli-attacks-three-sources-say-2026-02-28/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy|IRGC Navy]] announces the closure of the [[Strait of Hormuz]] to all vessels. [https://www.news18.com/world/iran-announces-closure-of-strait-of-hormuz-bars-vessel-movement-report-ws-l-9935851.html (News18)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-revolutionary-guards-tell-ships-passage-through-strait-hormuz-not-allowed-2026-02-28/ (Reuters)]
**At least 180 people, mostly schoolgirls, are killed in an [[2026 Minab school airstrike|airstrike on an elementary school in Minab, Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/2/28/over-50-killed-in-strike-on-girls-elementary-school-in-iran (Al Jazeera)] [https://efe.com/en/latest-news/2026-02-28/at-least-40-girls-killed-in-israeli-strike-on-iranian-school/ (EFE)] [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20260228-us-israeli-strike-on-iranian-school-kills-more-than-50-students-state-media-says (France 24)] [https://www.newarab.com/news/massacre-us-israel-strike-kills-51-southern-iran-school (The New Arab)]
**The [[Iranian Red Crescent Society]] reports 201 people have been killed and 747 others have been injured so far in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] and [[United States Armed Forces|American]] strikes on Iran. [https://apnews.com/live/live-updates-israel-iran-february-28-2026 (AP)]
**An Iranian missile strikes [[Tel Aviv]], killing a woman, and wounding at least 22 other people, including several seriously, and badly damaging several buildings. [[Search and rescue]] efforts are underway. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/bj3sy0gt11l (Ynet News)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/medics-say-at-least-20-hurt-in-tel-aviv-missile-strike-1-person-critical/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**One person is killed and seven others are wounded in an Iranian airstrike on [[Zayed International Airport]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], United Arab Emirates, while four are injured in a similar airstrike on [[Dubai International Airport]]. [https://www.newswire.lk/2026/03/01/one-killed-seven-injure-at-abu-dhabi-airport-amid-iranian-strikes/ (Newswire)] [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/311346/dubai-airport-damaged-four-wounded-in-incident-statement (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
* [[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Yemen]]'s [[Houthis]] announce the resumption of attacks on [[Red Sea]] shipping routes and on Israel in support of Iran. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-protests-us-aircraft-carrier-crackdown-yemen-e0a6b3c72775348c553ad185af5bfb20 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 21 people are killed and eight others are injured in an explosion at a [[firecracker]] factory in [[Kakinada]], [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/blast-at-india-firecracker-factory-kills-21-media (AFP via CTV News)]
*Six people, including [[Parliament of Kenya]] legislator [[Johana Ng'eno]], are killed when an [[Airbus Helicopters H125]] crashes in [[Nandi County]], [[Kenya]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/567466 (Aviation Safety Network)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kenyan-mp-among-six-people-killed-helicopter-crash-2026-03-01/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed when an [[Supply depot|ammunition and missile depot]] belonging to the [[National Guard (Suwayda)|National Guard]] detonates in [[Suwayda]], [[Sweida Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/middleeastnews/908270/five-killed-in-south-syria-by-depot-explosion-not-iran-missile-state-t/en (AFP via LBCI)] [https://arabi21.com/story/1740880/%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-4-%D8%A3%D8%B4%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B5-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B3%D9%82%D9%88%D8%B7-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%AE-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%B4%D8%A7%D9%87%D8%AF (Arabi21 <small>in Arabic</small>)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in Cuba]]
**[[Cuba]]n authorities arrest ten [[Panama]]nian nationals in [[Havana]], accusing them of creating anti-[[Politics of Cuba|government]] signs in exchange for being paid [[United States dollar|US$]]1,000–1,500 and charging them under laws that [[Censorship in Cuba|prohibit propaganda]] against [[Constitution of Cuba|the constitution]], offenses that carry prison terms of three to eight years. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/03/02/ten-panamanians-held-cuba-subversive-signs/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cuba-arrests-10-panamanians-making-subversive-signs-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)]
